description: First FMCG is a B2B wholesale marketplace for fast-moving consumer goods (food, drinks, snacks, household, personal care and more). Buyers can search live stock offers across suppliers, compare normalized per-piece prices, view offer details, and send purchase requests — supplier identities stay anonymous until they accept. Suppliers can publish and manage their own offers directly from chat, including from a pasted price list. 0% commission, direct supplier contact.
